name: Supply and Demand
summary: In Booty Bay, Drizzlik is preparing an order for Director Riddlevox, chief inventor of the Tinkers' Union. The leathercrafter claims to be the finest in the South Seas and beyond.

sections.title: An Order from the Tinkers' Union
sections.body: Drizzlik calls his leatherwork exquisite and famed everywhere. Director Riddlevox has ordered twelve Excelsior-line boots, among Drizzlik's best sellers and the boots Riddlevox favors. To begin shaping them, Drizzlik needs skins from crocolisks by the northern Stranglethorn river. His equipment is ready, and leaving so important a customer unsatisfied would be a poor idea.

sections.title: Once the Skins Arrive
sections.body: Drizzlik finds the skins good enough for the boots. Their fineness matters little because they form the inner layer, but they still need to be comfortable. If the skins are too stiff, tiger blood can soften them. It is one of the tricks of the trade.

faq.answer: Drizzlik is a leathercrafter in Booty Bay who claims to be the finest in the South Seas and beyond.
Director Riddlevox, chief inventor of the Tinkers' Union, ordered twelve Excelsior-line boots.

faq.q: Where are the crocolisks found for this commission?
aliases: where do i find the skins
faq.answer: The crocolisks for Drizzlik's commission live by the northern Stranglethorn river.

faq.q: How many skins does Drizzlik want?
faq.answer: Drizzlik wants two large river crocolisk skins.
